senses.gloss: (cmp. רָמַס) [to crush, denom. רֶמֶץ,] to roll or bake in hot ashes (רֶמֶץ). Part. pass. רָמוּץ; f. רְמוּצָה; דלעת הר׳ a certain kind of cucumbers made edible by baking in hot ashes, Bitter Apple.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:1">Ned. VI, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 49a">49ᵃ</cite>) <he>דלעת הר׳</he> (Bab. ed. <cite ref="E00877"><he>הרמוצא</he></cite>), expl. ib. 51ᵃ <he>דלעת הטמונה ברמץ</he> a cucumber steeped in hot ashes; (another definition, v. <cite ref="S02160"><he>קַרְקוֹזָאָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:5">Kil. I, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:5">Tosef. ib. I, 5</cite>, expl. Y. ib. I, 27ᵃ <he>כמין דלעת מרה … ברמץ</he> a kind of bitter cucumber which is sweetened by rolling it in ashes; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:1:7">Y. Ned. VI, 39ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ברימצא</he>.
